name: visual-regression.dev
description: A guide to visual regression testing: how it works, which tools exist and how they compare. It also hosts a shared run manifest, a format that lets different tools and platforms exchange the results of their runs.
note: Open standard for test run data, shared across tools.
alt: visual-regression.dev homepage introducing visual regression testing and a shared run manifest

name: Pixsame
description: A platform for visual regression testing. It starts with a Cypress plugin that diffs screenshots, and the tools around it are built on the shared run manifest format.
alt: Pixsame homepage with the headline Visual regression that agrees with itself and a demo UI card

name: DigestWeb
description: A news portal that collects handpicked stories about web development and AI into a daily feed. Readers can follow it through RSS, Atom or JSON Feed.
alt: DigestWeb feed for 28 October 2026 with editor-picked AI and web development articles

name: Krzyżówka ZNAK
description: An interactive Polish crossword for the Znak monthly, styled after the New York Times one. A Vue app runs inside WordPress through a custom plugin, and a solved puzzle earns the reader a code for a cheaper subscription.
alt: Krzyżówka ZNAK playable 5 by 5 crossword grid with the clue list on the right

name: Skarpetoholik
description: An online sock shop on WordPress. Its behaviour comes from custom plugins.
alt: Skarpetoholik shop homepage with a hero banner of mismatched colourful socks

name: Takapara
description: Another sock store on WordPress, with its own custom plugins.
alt: Takapara online shop homepage with a Halloween colourful socks campaign banner

name: Fast angle
description: A simple online protractor: load an image and measure any angle directly on it. It runs in the browser as a PWA, and the same code ships as an Android app (a trusted web activity) and an iOS hybrid app.
note: One codebase, three ways to install: web, Google Play and the App Store.
alt: Fast angle web app with an empty measurement board, a toolbar for loading an image, undo, zoom and fullscreen

name: Unsound Festival
description: The website of the Unsound music festival, built together with Grupa Robocza. It is deliberately light on CPU and network: plain HTML, SCSS with CSS modules, minified class names and no framework. The design is minimal and typography-based, with an interactive map of that year's festival venues.
note: The backend is PHP, which the client required, with Directus as the CMS and our own panels and modifications.
alt: Unsound New York 2019 festival homepage with city collage hero and artist photo grid

name: Kreator Domu
description: An app that brought investors, designers and contractors together. Users could plan the renovation or construction of a house, plan purchases with a product search, and build moodboards. After that they could find a contractor, using offers, messages and a shared calendar.
alt: Kreator Domu cost estimate screen with rooms in a sidebar, wall dimensions and a material picker

name: eRejestracja
description: A virtual practice portal for a group of dental clinics, built on ASSECO software. We set it up on Windows Server to meet the conditions of a European Funds grant.
alt: eRejestracja patient portal home page of a group of dental clinics in Kraków

name: Tauron Smart Home
description: A web dashboard where Tauron customers manage their smart home: sockets, bulbs, thermometers, smoke and motion detectors, radiators and a TV.
alt: Smart home web dashboard showing room tabs, temperature, humidity, air quality, pressure and power usage
